whyMatters.en: Trent Reznor’s industrial-rock project; The Downward Spiral (1994) brought sequenced aggression and studio-as-instrument to US rock mass media.
whyMatters.zh: Trent Reznor 的工业摇滚项目；The Downward Spiral（1994）把音序攻击与「录音室即乐器」送进美国摇滚大众媒介。

shortBio.en: Industrial rock as one-man studio band; Closer is the 1994 crossover single.
shortBio.zh: 一人录音室编制的工业摇滚；Closer 是 1994 跨界单曲。

body.en:
Started Cleveland 1988. Pretty Hate Machine and Broken EPs built the live/industrial hybrid; The Downward Spiral and The Fragile are the dense studio peaks—sampling, distorted vocals, programmed drums beside live kits.

Closer (1994) is the MTV/radio spike. NIN matters in a guitar-band chronicle as the 1990s proof that rock dynamics can be built from machines without exiting rock radio.
body.zh:
1988 年于克利夫兰起步。Pretty Hate Machine 与 Broken EP 建立现场/工业混合；The Downward Spiral 与 The Fragile 是密集录音室高峰——采样、失真人声、程序鼓与真人鼓组并存。

Closer（1994）是 MTV/电台尖峰。在吉他乐队编年里，NIN 证明 1990 年代摇滚动态可用机器搭建且不退出摇滚电台。
